BASE.name: ATTACK_VECTOR
BASE.justification: The session is attacked through the web application over the network.

BASE.name: ATTACK_COMPLEXITY
BASE.justification: The attacker must first plant a known session identifier in the victim's browser.

BASE.name: PRIVILEGES_REQUIRED
BASE.justification: The attacker needs no account of their own.

BASE.name: USER_INTERACTION
BASE.justification: The victim must log in using the fixed session.

BASE.name: SCOPE
BASE.justification: Access is limited to the same application.

BASE.name: CONFIDENTIALITY
BASE.justification: The attacker can read the victim's account data.

BASE.name: INTEGRITY
BASE.justification: The attacker can act as the victim and modify their data.

BASE.name: AVAILABILITY
BASE.justification: There is no direct impact on availability.

TEMPORAL.name: EXPLOIT_CODE_MATURITY

TEMPORAL.name: REPORT_CONFIDENCE
TEMPORAL.justification: The issue is identified by data-flow analysis from source to sink.
